# Metrics reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_metrics_doc.py from the metric declarations; do not edit. -->

Each collector only runs where it is supported (see `--list-collectors`), so a host
exposes the subset of these metrics that applies to its hardware and software.

## system

CPU, memory, load, pressure stall info, kernel counters, host info.

| Metric | Type | Labels | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `node_boot_time_seconds` | gauge | - | Boot time as a Unix timestamp. |
| `node_context_switches_total` | counter | - | Context switches since boot. |
| `node_cpu_count` | gauge | `type` | Number of CPUs (logical threads or physical cores). |
| `node_cpu_frequency_hertz` | gauge | `cpu`, `type` | CPU frequency (current, min, max). |
| `node_cpu_guest_seconds_total` | counter | `cpu`, `mode` | Seconds the CPUs spent running guests (already included in user/nice). |
| `node_cpu_seconds_total` | counter | `cpu`, `mode` | Seconds the CPUs spent in each mode. |
| `node_cpu_throttles_total` | counter | `cpu`, `type` | Thermal throttling events. |
| `node_cpu_usage_percent` | gauge | `cpu` | CPU busy percentage since the previous collection. |
| `node_entropy_available_bits` | gauge | - | Available kernel entropy. |
| `node_filefd_allocated` | gauge | - | Allocated file handles. |
| `node_filefd_maximum` | gauge | - | Maximum number of file handles. |
| `node_forks_total` | counter | - | Processes created since boot. |
| `node_info` | gauge | `hostname`, `kernel`, `os`, `architecture`, `cpu_model` | Host identity; the value is always 1. |
| `node_intr_total` | counter | - | Interrupts serviced since boot. |
| `node_load1` | gauge | - | 1 minute load average. |
| `node_load15` | gauge | - | 15 minute load average. |
| `node_load5` | gauge | - | 5 minute load average. |
| `node_memory_Active_anon_bytes` | gauge | - | Memory information field Active_anon. |
| `node_memory_Active_bytes` | gauge | - | Memory information field Active. |
| `node_memory_Active_file_bytes` | gauge | - | Memory information field Active_file. |

## filesystem

Filesystem size, free space and inodes (with stuck-mount protection).

| Metric | Type | Labels | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `node_filesystem_avail_bytes` | gauge | `device`, `mountpoint`, `fstype` | Space available to non-root users. |
| `node_filesystem_device_error` | gauge | `device`, `mountpoint`, `fstype` | Whether statfs() failed or timed out for this filesystem. |
| `node_filesystem_files` | gauge | `device`, `mountpoint`, `fstype` | Total inodes. |
| `node_filesystem_files_free` | gauge | `device`, `mountpoint`, `fstype` | Free inodes. |
| `node_filesystem_free_bytes` | gauge | `device`, `mountpoint`, `fstype` | Free space, including root-reserved. |
| `node_filesystem_readonly` | gauge | `device`, `mountpoint`, `fstype` | Whether the filesystem is read-only. |
| `node_filesystem_size_bytes` | gauge | `device`, `mountpoint`, `fstype` | Filesystem size. |

## smart

| `node_disk_smart_power_cycles_total` | counter | `device`, `model` | Power cycles. |
| `node_disk_smart_power_on_hours_total` | counter | `device`, `model` | Power-on hours. |
| `node_disk_smart_read_bytes_total` | counter | `device`, `model` | NVMe host bytes read. |
| `node_disk_smart_reallocated_sectors` | gauge | `device`, `model` | Reallocated sectors (SAS: grown defects). |
| `node_disk_smart_spin_retry_count` | gauge | `device`, `model` | Spin-up retries. |
| `node_disk_smart_ssd_wearout_percent` | gauge | `device`, `model` | Share of the SSD's rated endurance used. |
| `node_disk_smart_standby` | gauge | `device` | Disk was in standby and not queried. |
| `node_disk_smart_temperature_celsius` | gauge | `device`, `model` | Disk temperature. |
| `node_disk_smart_udma_crc_errors` | gauge | `device`, `model` | Interface CRC errors (usually cabling). |
| `node_disk_smart_uncorrectable_sectors` | gauge | `device`, `model` | Offline uncorrectable sectors. |
| `node_disk_smart_unsafe_shutdowns_total` | counter | `device`, `model` | NVMe unsafe shutdowns. |
| `node_disk_smart_written_bytes_total` | counter | `device`, `model` | NVMe host bytes written. |

| `node_btrfs_used_bytes` | gauge | `uuid`, `label`, `type` | Space used inside chunks by type. |

systemd system state, failed units and per-service state.

| `node_systemd_system_state` | gauge | `state` | systemd system state (one series per state). |
| `node_systemd_unit_state` | gauge | `name`, `state`, `type` | Unit active state (one series per state; see --systemd.unit-include). |

UPS battery, load and power status via Network UPS Tools (upsc).

| Metric | Type | Labels | Description |

| `node_ups_battery_charge_percent` | gauge | `ups` | Battery charge. |
| `node_ups_battery_runtime_seconds` | gauge | `ups` | Estimated runtime on battery. |
| `node_ups_battery_voltage_volts` | gauge | `ups` | Battery voltage. |
| `node_ups_info` | gauge | `ups`, `manufacturer`, `model` | UPS identity; the value is always 1. |
| `node_ups_input_voltage_volts` | gauge | `ups` | Input voltage. |
| `node_ups_load_percent` | gauge | `ups` | Load, % of capacity. |
| `node_ups_low_battery` | gauge | `ups` | UPS reports low battery (LB). |
| `node_ups_on_battery` | gauge | `ups` | UPS is running on battery (OB). |
| `node_ups_online` | gauge | `ups` | UPS is on line power (OL). |
| `node_ups_output_voltage_volts` | gauge | `ups` | Output voltage. |
| `node_ups_power_nominal_watts` | gauge | `ups` | Nominal real power. |

| `node_ups_replace_battery` | gauge | `ups` | UPS asks for a new battery (RB). |
| `node_ups_temperature_celsius` | gauge | `ups` | UPS temperature. |

## exporter

Exporter self-monitoring and process metrics.

| Metric | Type | Labels | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `process_cpu_seconds_total` | counter | - | Total user and system CPU time spent by the exporter. |
| `process_max_fds` | gauge | - | Maximum number of open file descriptors. |
| `process_open_fds` | gauge | - | Number of open file descriptors. |
| `process_resident_memory_bytes` | gauge | - | Resident memory size of the exporter. |
| `process_start_time_seconds` | gauge | - | Start time of the exporter since the Unix epoch. |
| `process_virtual_memory_bytes` | gauge | - | Virtual memory size of the exporter. |
| `proxmox_exporter_build_info` | gauge | `version`, `python_version` | Exporter version; the value is always 1. |
| `proxmox_exporter_collector_duration_seconds` | gauge | `collector` | Duration of the last collector run. |
| `proxmox_exporter_collector_enabled` | gauge | `collector` | Whether a collector is enabled on this host (supported and not disabled). |
| `proxmox_exporter_collector_errors_total` | counter | `collector` | Failed collector runs since start. |
| `proxmox_exporter_collector_interval_seconds` | gauge | `collector` | Configured interval between collector runs. |
| `proxmox_exporter_collector_last_success_timestamp_seconds` | gauge | `collector` | Unix time of the last successful collector run. |
| `proxmox_exporter_collector_runs_total` | counter | `collector` | Collector runs since start. |
| `proxmox_exporter_collector_success` | gauge | `collector` | Whether the last run of the collector succeeded. |
